sections.chapter_title: Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller
sections.text_helper: Section 76.2 "Ethernet main features" in chapter 76 (Ethernet (ETH): gigabit media access control (GMAC) with DMA controller), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3972.
sections.section_content:
The Ethernet peripheral embeds a dedicated DMA for direct memory interface, a media
access controller (MAC) and a PHY interface block supporting several formats.
